text:

subject: Virtual coffee? working with Veriff & Onfido
text:
Hi [NAME],

We just onboarded Veriff, whom similar to [COMPANY] are building models for
more accurate document verification. I'd like to connect virtually and see
if you've faced similar challenges to them.

Improving training data quality at scale is the key problem we solve with
Onfido and Veriff. We've made the platform configurable to setup automated
annotation pipeline as well subsequent QA/ consensus workflows involving
human reviewers - with the objective of helping them improve accuracy in
detecting forged IDs.

Keen to exchange perspectives and get your thoughts on model accuracy at
[COMPANY]. How's your Friday afternoon looking for a virtual coffee?

subject: Coffee @RSNA [YEAR]
text:
Hi [NAME],

Given [COMPANY]'s focus, expect you'll be at RSNA in two weeks? We work with Flatiron Health, Viz.ai and Highmark Health to improve DICOM/NIfTI annotation quality - would love to connect over a coffee at the conference.

A key problem we solve with Radiology AI teams is to coordinate multi-reader annotation and QC across ML engineers and clinical experts. We address this with built-in consensus/adjudication workflows, structured review stages, and role-based access controls. Our hierarchical ontology builder ensures consistent, context-rich labelling across studies.

Would be great to exchange perspectives over a coffee. We'll be at RSNA Sunday (11/30) to Tuesday (12/2) - how's your schedule looking Monday afternoon?

text:

I understand you're familiar with Encord from the past. It seems like your
team is focusing automating annotation so I want to reconnect. You might
find our recent projects with Nexar, Motive and Woven (Toyota) interesting

place - helping reduce need of manual annotation and improve label quality.

afternoon if you're open to a catch up.
